extracted.name: Spanish Rice Chicken I
extracted.description: Packaged Spanish rice teams with your best salsa, tomatoes and chicken for a one-skillet dish that is sure to please.
ingredient_lines: 1 skinless, boneless chicken breast half - cut into cubes
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instruction_lines: In a large skillet over medium heat prepare rice according to package directions, using the butter/margarine to brown the vermicelli and rice to a golden brown. Add the water, chicken, salsa and tomatoes and bring all to a boil. Cover skillet, reduce heat and let simmer for approximately 25 to 30 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed.
